newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: France completes Congo pullout.
newsitem.headline: France completes Congo pullout.

text.p: France completed its withdrawal from the war-ravaged Congo Republic capital Brazzaville on Friday after evacuating almost 6,000 French and other foreign nationals, the French ambassador there said.

"Yes, as far as I know they have all left," Ambassador Raymond Cesaire told Reuters in Kinshasa by telehpone from Brazzaville. He said 30 gendarmes remained in the city to protect French diplomats -- the ambassador and 12 other people.
U.N. special envoy Mohamed Sahnoun and Congo's President Pascal Lissouba had urged France to leave its forces in the city beyond the Friday midnight expiry of a 72-hour ceasefire.
Fighting broke out on June 5 between Lissouba loyalists and a militia loyal to his rival and predecessor, former military leader Denis Sassou Nguesso.
